Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.services

Class SikuliScreenCapture

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.services.SikuliScreenCapture
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScreenCaptureService
@Component public class SikuliScreenCapture extends Object implements ScreenCaptureService
Sikuli-based implementation of the ScreenCaptureService interface.

This implementation uses Sikuli's screen capture capabilities, which internally use platform-specific methods for efficient capture. It is completely independent of the Find action and other high-level Brobot components.

Key characteristics:

  • No dependencies on Find or Action classes
  • Thread-safe through stateless operations
  • Multi-monitor support
  • Efficient region capture
Since:
2.0.0

    • captureScreen

      public BufferedImage captureScreen()
      Description copied from interface: ScreenCaptureService
      Captures the entire primary screen.

      This method captures a screenshot of the primary monitor. In multi-monitor setups, this typically refers to the main display as determined by the operating system.

      Specified by:
      captureScreen in interface ScreenCaptureService
      Returns:
      BufferedImage containing the screen contents, or null if capture fails

    • captureRegion

      public BufferedImage captureRegion(int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Description copied from interface: ScreenCaptureService
      Captures a specific region of the screen.

      This method captures only the specified rectangular area of the screen, which can improve performance when only a portion of the screen is needed.

      Specified by:
      captureRegion in interface ScreenCaptureService
      Parameters:
      x - X coordinate of the region's top-left corner
      y - Y coordinate of the region's top-left corner
      width - Width of the region to capture
      height - Height of the region to capture
      Returns:
      BufferedImage containing the region contents, or null if capture fails or region is invalid
